buyer_question: Can the AI answer diagnosis, medication, lab-result, symptom or treatment-plan questions?
evidence_to_prepare: Approved administrative-only scope, blocked-topic list, clinical handoff route and sampled transcripts
human_review_trigger: Any diagnosis, medication, test result interpretation, worsening symptom, care plan or emergency phrase
unsafe_automation_to_block: Do not let an AI receptionist provide medical advice or replace clinician judgement
boundary_label: Template row only; not medical advice, clinical approval or HIPAA compliance proof

buyer_question: What PHI/ePHI is used, stored, logged or sent to vendors?
evidence_to_prepare: Data-category register, redacted workflow screenshots, retention notes and vendor data-use terms
human_review_trigger: Any raw patient identifier, chart note, insurance detail, referral attachment or appointment context leaves approved systems
unsafe_automation_to_block: Do not paste PHI/ePHI into unapproved AI tools, demos, tickets or public examples
boundary_label: Template row only; not privacy legal security or HIPAA advice

buyer_question: Which appointment requests can be handled administratively?
evidence_to_prepare: Scheduling rules, opt-out language, queue owner, SLA and unresolved callback report
human_review_trigger: Complex reschedule, recurring no-show, complaint, accessibility need or unclear patient intent
unsafe_automation_to_block: Do not mark a patient handled without staff-visible status and owner
boundary_label: Template row only; not patient outcome booking lift or revenue proof

buyer_question: Can AI explain benefits, prior auth, copay, denial or billing questions?
evidence_to_prepare: Approved billing scripts, escalation owner, payer/authorization evidence fields and limitation wording
human_review_trigger: Coverage interpretation, denial appeal, financial hardship, coding, prior-auth clinical evidence or disputed balance
unsafe_automation_to_block: Do not promise coverage, cost, coding, authorization or payment outcome
boundary_label: Template row only; not billing coding payer legal or financial advice

buyer_question: How will AICS answer AI-use and vendor-risk questions safely?
evidence_to_prepare: Answer-source map, BAA/subprocessor question list, SOC 2/HITRUST status field, evidence ageing and owner approval
human_review_trigger: Unknown subprocessor, missing BAA answer, stale policy, unsupported certification, customer data-use ambiguity
unsafe_automation_to_block: Do not claim SOC 2, HITRUST, HIPAA compliance or BAA status unless evidence owner approves exact wording
boundary_label: Template row only; not certification audit legal or procurement advice

buyer_question: Who owns AI spend spikes, untagged cloud resources and patient-workflow cost exposure?
evidence_to_prepare: Cloud/AI spend export, owner tags, budget threshold, anomaly alert route and approval log
human_review_trigger: Unowned resource, unbudgeted model usage, sudden inference spike, PHI-related workload ambiguity or renewal blocker
unsafe_automation_to_block: Do not claim savings, ROI or cost reduction from this template
boundary_label: Template row only; not savings ROI revenue or FinOps outcome proof

buyer_question: What happens when AI gives a wrong answer or a patient complains?
evidence_to_prepare: Incident log fields, severity rubric, containment route, patient-access owner and external-claim hold
human_review_trigger: Wrong answer, patient complaint, privacy incident suspicion, emergency phrase, reputational issue or regulator/auditor question
unsafe_automation_to_block: Do not continue autonomous handling after a complaint or suspected incident without human review
boundary_label: Template row only; not legal security medical audit or incident-response advice

buyer_question: What can marketing or sales say about the AI workflow?
evidence_to_prepare: Approved claim register, evidence source, date, owner, limitation and prohibited-claim list
human_review_trigger: Any claim about compliance, safety, accuracy, clinical quality, patient satisfaction, wait-time, revenue or search ranking
unsafe_automation_to_block: Do not publish unsupported outcomes, testimonials, logos or compliance badges
boundary_label: Template row only; not customer testimonial ranking outcome or revenue proof
